```{r farmerFishTradeoffTable01, echo = F, warning =F}

scenario_tab_init = get_scenario_tab_init()
scenario_tab_init = scenario_tab_init[scenario_tab_init$scenario_category!="Attr",]
coef_tab = coef_tab[, c("Predictor", "Value")]

# Calculate mean of 35 years of hydrologic benefit value and ET
obj_fn_results = get_HBF_and_crop_ET_columns(scenario_tab = scenario_tab_init,
                                        lasso_weights = coef_tab)

scenario_tab = obj_fn_results$scenario_tab
obj_fn_wy = obj_fn_results$obj_fn_results_by_wy

# replace transformed data with straight abundance data for better interpretability

# for scenario tab
scenario_tab$hb_untrans_mean = 10^scenario_tab$HBF_mean
scenario_tab$hb_untrans_stdev = 10^scenario_tab$HBF_stdev

colnames(scenario_tab) = gsub(pattern = "HBF",
                              replacement = "HBF_log10",
                              x = colnames(scenario_tab))
colnames(scenario_tab) = gsub(pattern = "hb_untrans",
                              replacement = "HBF",
                              x = colnames(scenario_tab))

# for obj_fn_wy
obj_fn_wy$hbf_total_untrans = 10^obj_fn_wy$hbf_total
colnames(obj_fn_wy)[colnames(obj_fn_wy)=="hbf_total"] = "hbf_total_log10"
colnames(obj_fn_wy)[colnames(obj_fn_wy)=="hbf_total_untrans"] = "hbf_total"

```{r FJFlow, echo = F, fig.cap="\\label{fig:fjflow} Simulated FJ daily average flow (basis for functional flows, which is the basis for HB function values) for multiple scenarios." , warning=F}

fig_path = file.path(save_figs_here, paste0("Figure ",fig_i,".png"))
if(print_for_slides==T){
  png(filename=fig_path,width=7,height=5,unit="in",res=300)
  
  plot_start = as.Date("2002-07-01"); plot_end = as.Date("2005-01-01")
  plot_start =  as.Date("1991-10-01"); plot_end = as.Date("2025-09-30")
  plot_start = as.Date("2000-07-01"); plot_end = as.Date("2005-01-01")
  
  scen_id = "basecase"
  fj_scen = scen_fj_out[,c("Date",scen_id)]
  fj_plot = fj_scen[fj_scen$Date>= plot_start & fj_scen$Date <= plot_end,]
  plot(x = fj_plot$Date, y=fj_plot$basecase, type = "l",
       ylim = c(min(fj_plot[,scen_id]), max(fj_plot[,scen_id]*10)),
       xlab = "Date", ylab = "FJ Sim. Flow (cfs)",
       log="y", yaxt="n")
  if((plot_end-plot_start)/365 < 5){
    verts=seq.Date(from=floor_date(x=plot_start, unit ="year"),
                 to=ceiling_date(x=plot_end, unit = "year"),
                 by="quarter")
  } else {
    verts=seq.Date(from=floor_date(x=plot_start, unit ="year"),
                 to=ceiling_date(x=plot_end, unit = "year"),
                 by="year")
  }
  
  y_orders = floor(log10(min(fj_plot[,scen_id]))):
               (1+ceiling(log10(max(fj_plot[,scen_id]))))
  horz = 10^(y_orders)
  abline(v=verts, h=horz, col = "gray", lty = 2)
  axis(side=2,at=horz, labels = as.character(horz))
  axis(side=2,at=rep(1:9,length(y_orders))*sort(rep(10^y_orders,9)),
       tck=-.015, labels =NA)
  
  for(i in 2:length(plot_scenarios1)){
    scen_id = plot_scenarios1[i]
    fj_scen = scen_fj_out[,c("Date",scen_id)]
    fj_plot = fj_scen[fj_scen$Date>= plot_start & fj_scen$Date <= plot_end,]
    lines(x=fj_plot$Date, y=fj_plot[,scen_id], col = scen_cols[i])
  }

  legend(x="topright",ncol=3,legend =plot_scenarios1, cex=.8,
         # bty="n",
         col = scen_cols, lwd=2)  

dev.off()
}
knitr::include_graphics(fig_path)
fig_i = fig_i + 1

# but the functional flows?? why is fall flow diff weird for the 3 alf categories?
show_this =F
if(show_this){
  plot_scenarios1
  ff_scen = ffs_scenarios[[scen_id]]

  FA_dif = data.frame(brood_year = ffs_scenarios[["basecase"]]$Brood_Year,

```{r efficiency01, echo = F, fig.cap="\\label{fig:efficiency} Scenario trade-off efficiencies, or average Hydrologic Benefit value (a proxy for environmental benefit) gained per crop ET value lost (a proxy for farmer cost) (normalized to average basecase HB and ET values, respectively), in all 35 years. Some scenarios are excluded if they have no or negative ET loss, producing infinite or negative efficiency values." , warning=F}


bc_sel = scenario_tab$scenario_id=="basecase"
hb_bc_mean = scenario_tab$HBF_mean[bc_sel]
et_bc_mean = scenario_tab$et_mean[bc_sel]
scenario_tab$hb_gained = (scenario_tab$HBF_mean - hb_bc_mean)/hb_bc_mean
scenario_tab$et_lost = (scenario_tab$et_mean - et_bc_mean)/et_bc_mean *-1

scenario_tab$hb_gained_to_et_lost = round(scenario_tab$hb_gained / scenario_tab$et_lost, 2)

fig_path = file.path(save_figs_here, paste0("Figure ",fig_i,".png"))
if(print_for_slides==T){
  png(filename = fig_path, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300)
  tradeoff_efficiency_fig_nov2025(scenario_tab = scenario_tab)
  dev.off()
}
knitr::include_graphics(fig_path)
fig_i = fig_i + 1




```

```{r scenarioResultsTab01, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}

# subset desired columns
scen_tab = scenario_tab[,c("scenario_id", "scenario_category", "feas_cat", 
                           "HBF_mean", "et_mean", "pareto_opt",
                           "hb_gained_to_et_lost")]
if(max(scen_tab$HBF_mean) > 2000){
  scen_tab$HBF_mean = round(scen_tab$HBF_mean / 1000, 2)
  mean_HB_text = "Mean HB / 1000"
} else {
  scen_tab$HBF_mean = round(scen_tab$HBF_mean, 2)
  mean_HB_text = "Mean HB"
}

scen_tab$et_mean = round(scen_tab$et_mean)
# remove the negative efficiencies - that means ET was gained, not lost, so it doesn't apply
scen_tab$hb_gained_to_et_lost = round(scen_tab$hb_gained_to_et_lost, 2)
scen_tab$hb_gained_to_et_lost[scenario_tab$hb_gained <=0 | 
                                scenario_tab$et_lost <=0 |
                                !is.finite(scen_tab$hb_gained_to_et_lost) |
                                scen_tab$scenario_id == "basecase" ] = "--"
scen_tab$et_mean = round(scenario_tab$et_mean * (-1 / 10^6), 2)

# Exclude attribution scenarios
scen_tab = scen_tab[scen_tab$scenario_category != "Attr",]

#Create caption and column labels
caption_text = "Scenario attributes for 25 scenarios. Values in the Mean Hydrologic Benefit (HB) and Mean ET columns are averages of 35 annual values for each scenario. Efficiency not calculated for scenarios with no average ET loss."
column_labels = c("Scenario ID", "Category", "Feas.", mean_HB_text, "Mean ET",  "Pareto", "Efficiency")

scen_tab_for_ft = scen_tab
colnames(scen_tab_for_ft) = column_labels

st_ft = flextable(scen_tab_for_ft)
st_ft = set_caption(st_ft, caption = caption_text)

st_ft = flextable::fontsize(st_ft,j=1,  size = 10)
st_ft = flextable::fontsize(st_ft,j=2,  size = 10)
st_ft = flextable::fontsize(st_ft,j=3,  size = 10)
st_ft = flextable::fontsize(st_ft,j=4,  size = 10)
st_ft = flextable::fontsize(st_ft,j=5,  size = 10)
st_ft = flextable::fontsize(st_ft,j=6,  size = 10)
st_ft = flextable::fontsize(st_ft,j=7,  size = 10)

# st_ft = flextable::rotate(st_ft, rotation="btlr",j=1:8)
st_ft = flextable::width(st_ft,j=1,  width = 1.7)
